resolutionRule: An active conflict or missing applicable structured authority keeps protected evaluation ineligible; this package does not guess or choose an authority.

gaps.finding: The live reciprocal suggestion query accepts any equal offer mode, while the invitation RPC only accepts nonfinancial pledge offers.
gaps.candidateBehavior: The synthetic candidate narrows to pledge and reports the overall source status as blocked_source_conflict; it does not declare that narrowing canonical.
gaps.requiredResolution: Product and policy owners must select and enforce one structured matchability contract across suggestion, invitation, and research projection paths.

gaps.finding: startSuggestedMatchAction does not re-run reciprocal causes, open state, same mode, invitation compatibility, or the full structured gate set. New active-thread insertion is pair-block-triggered, but the action selects any non-closed thread and can continue from blocked thread state. The Feed private-delivery path applies a different source-bound transaction contract.
gaps.candidateBehavior: The pure evaluator requires all normalized gates and remains disconnected from runtime.
gaps.requiredResolution: Create one transaction-safe runtime authority and prove every call site uses it before any research source can be called canonical.

gaps.finding: Structured fail-closed moderation, noncompensable match-candidate safety, validity, baseline, and participant-policy evaluators exist, but ordinary publication, Feed private delivery, and reciprocal matching do not bind current records from them.
gaps.candidateBehavior: Only explicitly normalized cleared/current/time-valid evidence carrying the exact policy-manifest hash passes synthetic evaluation; empty moderation prose and free-text review are never clearance.
gaps.requiredResolution: Bind the applicable structured records and effective-time semantics to one enforced core matchability source.

gaps.finding: listReciprocalMatches delegates matching to PostgreSQL ILIKE, but the repository does not freeze the database locale/collation needed to reproduce every Unicode case-folding result.
gaps.candidateBehavior: The evaluator exactly labels and implements printable-ASCII PostgreSQL LIKE wildcard and case-insensitive semantics, then fails closed on non-ASCII or unbound collation.
gaps.requiredResolution: Freeze a database collation contract and add parity tests against the deployed database before protected projection.

gaps.finding: No approved study-specific privacy purpose, disclosure review, ethics determination, or consent/waiver authority exists for a protected Reciprocal Trade eligibility snapshot.
gaps.candidateBehavior: Synthetic fixtures carry synthetic consent records only; every protected input is ineligible even if it asserts approval flags.
gaps.requiredResolution: Obtain and bind explicit privacy, ethics, and consent/waiver determinations without equating account creation with research consent.

gaps.finding: Pair blocks and credibility restrictions have different shapes and time semantics, and no approved normalized research projection binds them atomically at one effective time.
gaps.candidateBehavior: The evaluator requires explicit pair-block and source/target/pair restriction states and fails closed on unknown, stale, or contradictory projections.
gaps.requiredResolution: Define and test an authorized, transaction-consistent projection with revocation and expiry semantics.

gaps.finding: No repository source atomically projects accepted interest, invitation, thread, agreement, duplicate-pair, and historical-interference state for a frozen research snapshot.
gaps.candidateBehavior: Every field is mandatory in normalized synthetic input; active conflicts and unknown history fail closed.
gaps.requiredResolution: Specify the frozen projection and distinguish current exclusion from retained historical interference covariates.

gaps.finding: The immutable aggregate evidence records zero eligible directed dyads and insufficient real graph readiness.
gaps.candidateBehavior: realGraphDiagnosticsStatus remains blocked_not_run and executionDecision remains no_launch.
gaps.requiredResolution: Only a future separately authorized aggregate re-inspection may determine whether the graph changed; this tranche reads no real rows.
